description: This file defines a PHP class PimReportSearchFilterParams that extends FilterParams and implements ReportSearchFilterParams, representing filter parameters for a report search within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

classes.name: PimReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class to encapsulate report search filter parameters, specifically the report ID.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID associated with this filter parameters object.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID for this filter parameters object.
